How the quote is worked out

Model-specific screen + installation. Any additional work is explained and agreed before it starts.

  1. Send the exact make and model, plus what’s damaged.
  2. Choose a screen preference, or ask to compare both.
  3. Review the available part, its condition, and the total quote.

If a genuine screen is available, the quote will state whether it’s new, refurbished, or used. The options also depend on the condition of your device.

Know what you’re paying for

  • An explanation of the problem and available repair options.
  • A quote for the parts and work before you approve it.
  • Checks of the repaired device and an explanation of any remaining issues.

Repair options and timing depend on the model, condition, and parts. Remote help, customer visits, and arranged drop-off are available; the right approach depends on the problem.
